vectors.description: each rule's selections and truth values, each test's truth values (between as one test, the test under a not), and the coverage they give, over cases without expectations
the tests of a condition under and, or and not, in depth-first pre-order, each located by its pointer and named by its op; connectives are not counted
a run of no cases counts nothing, and its coverage misses every item
a case whose evaluation raises an error counts as a case and in no rule, whether it expects the error or not, and a file that cannot be read counts nowhere
a case for which the hit policy raises hit_policy_error gives no decision, so the rules that fired in it are not counted

a decision table's rules in rule order (output order here) with their rows, each input cell that is not '-' as one condition (the test under a NOT, at the cell), the output values each selection gave, and a catch-all row that cannot be FALSE or UNKNOWN left out of those measures
a bundle's rules are located under /bundle, and a table without output values has no outputs to count and no output_value measure
a rule or a test that reads no field has one truth value, so it is left out of the total and the missed items of the measures of the other ones, and counted as unreachable there
a run interrupted by max_results counts only the cases it ran
